items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: And Mrs. Basie gave them some presentation up at the Apollo I think with Sarah.

ctx.x: Yes. And Mrs. Basie gave them some presentation up at the Apollo I think with Sarah. Sarah was there. We have a picture of it. But I remember all of them. They were wonderful. It was a happy time in my life.
Well we’ve spoken with a few of those members.
